_note: Midjourney SCENE PRESET registry. The canonical list of reusable scene presets for music videos and short visual stories. Each preset is a SCENE (what is in the frame) plus a FRAME (where the camera stands and what it names) plus a CUT (how the renderer turns it into video).
_why-split: Measured on this account, 2026-10-26 → 2026-11-01: a prompt clause naming an OBJECT IN THE FRAME is obeyed, while a clause naming a DISTANCE is not (the reference photo's framing wins the distance). So the camera's DISTANCE is not written in the prompt at all — it is the CUT's job. A preset that says 'wide shot' is lying about what Midjourney will do.
_why-no-flags: No preset carries --v, --style, --s/--stylize, --cref, --sref, --oref or --edit. (1) `--v 7` was MEASURED soft-banned on this account on 2026-10-26: a job id came back, the job was never queued, the CDN 404'd forever. `--v 8.2` is the account's proven engine and lives in lib/mj-config.json. (2) `--style raw --s 21` is the house recipe and lives in the config; buildFullPrompt drops the config's `--s` when the PROMPT names a style, so a preset naming one would silently reset stylize to 100. (3) `--oref` is REFUSED on this account with no `--v`, and REFUSED again with `--v 8.2`; only `--v 7 --oref` was accepted and that engine soft-bans.
_why-no-race: Per the repo's prompt-lint rule (docs/PROMPT-LINT.md): a prompt must not name the subject's race or ethnicity, because the reference photo is authoritative. Every preset describes the SCENE — light, lens, medium, mood, era, wardrobe, gesture, setting — and leaves the person to the reference.
_house-tail: Every preset's frame clause ends with the house texture and negation tail: 'fine natural film grain, muted palette, no text'. That tail is part of the look, not decoration.

schema.slug: stable kebab-case handle — the programmatic address
schema.name: display name, shown in the doc and carried in the pack
schema.group: one of: music-video, electronic-pop, story-video, vertical
schema.prose: the SCENE — the physical event, the environment, the light. Subject-first, one idea.
schema.frame: the FRAME — where the camera stands and what it names IN the picture. Never a distance.

cut.motion: a renderer motion: none, zoom-in, zoom-out, pan-left
cut.fx: the per-shot look: one name, or stacked with +
cut.grade: the look applied ONCE to the joined cut
cut.mode: the cut mode: cut, crossfade, kenburns

presets.name: Neon Night Drive
presets.bestFor: electronic, synthwave, R&B, night-drive anthems
presets.prose: A driver in a dark jacket behind the wheel of a car on a rain-soaked street at night, the windshield beaded with water, neon signs smeared into wet asphalt, a passenger's hand on the gear stick
presets.frame: the camera low beside the front wheel at street level, the door frame passing close across the edges of the picture, the wet road filling the lower third, fine natural film grain, muted palette, no text

presets.name: Desert Ritual
presets.bestFor: cinematic pop, world music, emotional ballads
presets.prose: A lone dancer in flowing white fabric turning slowly in a vast red desert, dust lifting in the air around the hem, long shadows running away from the low sun
presets.frame: the camera low in the sand looking across the dune toward the figure, the ridge line cutting across the frame, warm dust in the air, fine natural film grain, muted palette, no text

presets.name: Abandoned Warehouse Performance
presets.bestFor: rock, hip-hop, dark pop, industrial electronic
presets.prose: A singer standing alone in an abandoned industrial warehouse, one hand lifted off the microphone, dust drifting through the air
presets.frame: the camera at chest height in the middle of the floor facing the singer square on, the steel columns passing close at the edges of the picture, a single hard spotlight from above, fine natural film grain, muted palette, no text
